Answer: A
Reason: Comparing the initial chest X-ray (Figure 1a) with the post-treatment image (Figure 1b), there is a clear reduction in the size of the left-sided mediastinal mass and opacity. This decrease in mass effect has allowed the mediastinum to return towards the midline (reducing the shift) and has resulted in the re-expansion of the previously collapsed left lower lobe, restoring normal lung aeration.
